# TEST MATERIAL — writing support fixtures

Every name, event, rule, direction, and passage in this directory is invented test material. None belongs to a real novel project or establishes approved canon. Normal source retrieval excludes this directory unless the operator explicitly selects synthetic mode.

`rules.md`, `scene.md`, and `followup.md` provide conflicting and consistent evidence, viewpoint controls, phase limits, deceptive accounts, reader ceilings, and separate clocks. `revision.md` is a clean bounded revision and handoff excerpt. `uncertain.md` contains deliberately conflicting, superseded, and unapproved test records; it is not selected for the default literary exercise.

Generate runnable derived inputs with `python scripts/writing_toolkit.py demo` when the toolkit is installed. Generated packets contain no model answers. Actual reviewer outputs are separate local artifacts.
